map.最近一次催款日期: Date of the most recent demand for payment
map.对方最近承诺还款日期: Date of the debtor's most recent promise to repay
map.债务人有部分还款: The debtor made a partial repayment
map.有书面借条/欠条: There is a written IOU or promissory note
map.3年，从知道或应当知道权利受侵害及义务人之日起算: 3 years from the date the creditor knows or should know of the infringement of the right and of the debtor
map.从还款期限届满之日起算3年: 3 years from the date the repayment deadline expires
map.债权人可随时要求返还，从主张权利之日起算3年；最长不超过20年: The creditor may demand repayment at any time and the 3 years run from the date the right is asserted; the maximum is 20 years
map.①权利人向义务人提出履行请求（发催款函、微信/短信催款、电话录音等）②义务人同意: (1) the creditor demands performance (demand letter, message, recorded call, etc.); (2) the debtor agrees to perform (partial repayment, promise to pay, request for an extension); (3) suit or arbitration is filed. After interruption the 3 years start again.
map.债务人可提出不履行义务的抗辩（时效抗辩），但实体权利不消灭，债务人自愿履行的不得: The debtor may raise a limitation defence, but the underlying right is not extinguished; voluntary performance cannot be reclaimed
map.借条约定了还款日期，从届满日起算 3 年，计算丧失胜诉权的风险日。: Where an IOU fixes a repayment date, the 3 years run from that date; find the day you risk losing the right to win.
map.未约定还款期的，可随时主张，时效从第一次催款之日起算 3 年。: Where no date is fixed, demand may be made at any time and the 3 years run from the first demand.
map.催款、部分还款、对方承诺还款均构成时效中断，重新计算 3 年。: A demand, a partial repayment or a promise to pay all interrupt the period, which then restarts for 3 years.
map.约定还款日情形: Where a repayment date is agreed
map.借条约定 2023-06-01 还款，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满 2026-0: An IOU fixes repayment on 2023-06-01; the 3 years start the next day and expire on 2026-06-01. Without a demand or suit before then, enforcement becomes difficult once the period expires.
map.2024-06-01 书面催款并保留证据，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届满日: A written demand on 2024-06-01 with evidence kept restarts the 3 years from that date, with a new expiry of 2027-06-01; where there are several demands, the last one governs.
map.没有借条只有转账记录能算时效吗？: Can the period be computed with only a transfer record and no IOU?
map.转账记录可证明借贷关系，但起算点需结合聊天记录、催款证据确定；建议补写借条或留存: A transfer record can prove the loan, but the start date must be fixed with chat history and demand evidence; it is best to sign an IOU or keep proof of demands to settle the period.
map.超过 3 年就彻底要不回了吗？: After 3 years is the debt gone for good?
map.时效届满丧失的是胜诉权而非债权，对方自愿履行的有效；若对方不提出时效抗辩，法院不: Expiry costs the right to win, not the debt itself; voluntary payment remains valid and, since courts do not apply limitation of their own motion, recovery is still possible if the debtor raises no defence.
